rules.sentence: The proposed mechanisms behind this UV-induced DNA damage have led some to refer to AK as squamous cell carcinoma (SCC) in situ.
Additionally, immunosuppression has also led to the development of AKs.
UV radiation and smoking have been implicated as the major risk factor for developing BCC due to DNA damage.[49]
Several studies have identified mutations in the PTCH1 gene (of the sonic hedgehog pathway) and p53 tumor suppressor gene in patients with BCC.
The p53 tumor suppressor gene is critical to cell apoptosis and the prevention of tumorigenesis; a mutation in this gene leads to the uncontrolled growth of malignant cells.[50][51]
